certification.name: GIAC Experienced Forensics Examiner
certification.description: Applied Knowledge exam of 25 CyberLive hands-on challenges in four hours, open book, covering application execution evidence, deleted artifact recovery, cloud storage, browser and USB activity and account usage on Windows systems. Counts toward the GSE portfolio.
certification.currency_note: Applied Knowledge exam; $499 for holders of the corresponding active base Practitioner certification (GCFE is the audience named on the page)
